arxiv-2011-04445.title: TTVOS: Lightweight Video Object Segmentation with Adaptive Template Attention Module and Temporal Consistency Loss
arxiv-2011-04445.creator: Hyojin Park, Ganesh Venkatesh, Nojun Kwak
arxiv-2011-04445.description: Abstract . Semi-supervised video object segmentation (semi-VOS) is widely used in many applications. This task is tracking class-agnostic objects from a given target mask. For doing this, various approaches have been developed based on online-learning, memory networks, and optical flow.

arxiv-2105-04245.title: QNMs of branes, BHs and fuzzballs from Quantum SW geometries
arxiv-2105-04245.creator: Massimo Bianchi, Dario Consoli, Alfredo Grillo, Josè Francisco Morales
arxiv-2105-04245.description: Abstract QNMs govern the linear response to perturbations of BHs, D-branes and fuzzballs and the gravitational wave signals in the ring-down phase of binary mergers. A remarkable connection between QNMs of neutral BHs in 4d and quantum SW geometries describing the dynamics of 𝒩 = 2 {\cal N}=2 SYM theories has been recently put forward.

arxiv-2209-03175.title: On the utility and protection of optimization with differential privacy and classic regularization techniques
arxiv-2209-03175.creator: Eugenio Lomurno, Matteo Matteucci
arxiv-2209-03175.description: Abstract Nowadays, owners and developers of deep learning models must consider stringent privacy-preservation rules of their training data, usually crowd-sourced and retaining sensitive information. The most widely adopted method to enforce privacy guarantees of a deep learning model nowadays relies on optimization techniques enforcing differential privacy.

arxiv-2211-09804.title: Topologically distinct atomic insulators
arxiv-2211-09804.creator: Sanjib Kumar Das, Sourav Manna, Bitan Roy
arxiv-2211-09804.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sanjib Kumar Das, Sourav Manna, Bitan Roy. Topological classification of quantum solids often (if not always) groups all trivial atomic or normal insulators (NIs) into the same featureless family. As we argue here, this is not necessarily the case always.

arxiv-2303-08784.title: Query-guided Attention in Vision Transformers for Localizing Objects Using a Single Sketch
arxiv-2303-08784.creator: Aditay Tripathi Anand Mishra Anirban Chakraborty
arxiv-2303-08784.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the problem of sketch-based object localization on natural images, where given a crude hand-drawn sketch of an object, the goal is to localize all the instances of the same object on the target image.

arxiv-2308-08743.title: Is the glassy dynamics same in 2D as in 3D? The Adam Gibbs relation test
arxiv-2308-08743.creator: Santu Nath, Shiladitya Sengupta
arxiv-2308-08743.description: Abstract It has been recognized of late that even amorphous, glass-forming materials in two dimensions (2D) are significantly affected by Mermin-Wagner type long wavelength thermal fluctuation which is inconsequential in three (3D) and higher dimensions. Thus any study of glassy dynamics in 2D should first remove the effect of such fluctuations.

arxiv-2310-08928.title: SIDE: Self-supervised Intermediate Domain Exploration for Source-free Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2310-08928.creator: Jiamei Liu, Han Sun*, Yizhen Jia, Jie Qin, Huiyu Zhou, Ningzhong Liu
arxiv-2310-08928.description: Abstract Domain adaptation aims to alleviate the domain shift when transferring the knowledge learned from the source domain to the target domain. Due to privacy issues, source-free domain adaptation (SFDA), where source data is unavailable during adaptation, has recently become very demanding yet challenging.

arxiv-2405-15699.title: Dimension-free deterministic equivalents and scaling laws for random feature regression
arxiv-2405-15699.creator: Leonardo Defilippis, Bruno Loureiro, Theodor Misiakiewicz
arxiv-2405-15699.description: Abstract In this work we investigate the generalization performance of random feature ridge regression (RFRR). Our main contribution is a general deterministic equivalent for the test error of RFRR. Specifically, under a certain concentration property, we show that the test error is well approximated by a closed-form expression that only depends on the feature map eigenvalues.

arxiv-2604-02942.title: Explainable Machine Learning Reveals 12-Fold Ucp1 Upregulation and Thermogenic Reprogramming in Female Mouse White Adipose Tissue After 37 Days of Microgravity: First AI/ML Analysis of NASA OSD-970

doe-osti-3383025-complete-the-design-cos.creator: Root, Sam J., Hartvigsen, Jeremy Lee, Knighton, Todd et al.
doe-osti-3383025-complete-the-design-cos.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. This report details the design of a test stand that converts carbon dioxide and hydrogen into methanol via a two-step process. The first step is a reverse water-gas shift reaction, carried out at 600°C and 25 bar to reduce carbon dioxide to carbon monoxide, and the second is a sy

pmc-11521927.title: Revisiting the role of MicroRNAs in the pathogenesis of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
pmc-11521927.creator: Zhimin Zhou, Yuhong Xie, Qianru Wei, Xinyue Zhang, Zhihao Xu
pmc-11521927.description: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a prevalent chronic pulmonary fibrosis disease characterized by alveolar epithelial cell damage, fibroblast proliferation and activation, excessive extracellular matrix deposition, and abnormal epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), resulting in tissue remodeling and irreversible structural distortion. The mortality rate of IPF is very high, with a median survival time of 2–3 years after diagnosis.

pmc-12687051.title: Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation support in patients with difficult airway management: Case series of 13 patients
pmc-12687051.creator: Mugahid Eltahir, Ibrahim Fawzy, Abdulsalam Saif Ibrahim, Ezzeddin A Ibrahim, Rashid Mazhar, Nabil Abd Elhamid Shallik, Ayman El-Menyar, Ahmed Labib Shehatta
pmc-12687051.description: BACKGROUNDIn critical care practice, difficult airway management poses a substantial challenge, necessitating urgent intervention to ensure patient safety and optimize outcomes. Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) is a potential rescue tool in patients with severe airway compromise, although evidence of its efficacy and safety remains limited.AIMTo review the local experience of using ECMO support in patients with difficult airway management.

pmc-12873267.title: Near T2T haplotype-resolved genomes of cacao (Theobroma cacao) variety CCN51
pmc-12873267.creator: Huawei Tan, Yaxin Lou, Yuchen Yan, Lyndel W Meinhardt, Bryan Bailey, Osman Gutierrez, Sunchung Park, Stephen P Cohen, Dapeng Zhang, Yanbin Yin
pmc-12873267.description: As a cornerstone of the global chocolate industry, cacao cultivation supports millions of livelihoods. The modern hybrid variety CCN51 is the most widely planted cultivar in Latin America, valued for its exceptional yield, broad disease resistance, and superior adaptability. Here, we present a high-quality, haplotype-resolved, near Telomere-to-Telomere (T2T) genome assembly for CCN51, generated using PacBio HiFi long-reads and Hi-C data.

pmc-13092670.title: Pathways to participation – a scoping review outlining barriers and enablers to participation in dementia research
pmc-13092670.creator: Lukas A. Duffner, Soraya Moradi-Bachiller, Dianne Gove, Ana M. Diaz-Ponce, Angela Bradshaw, Jean Georges
pmc-13092670.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundOngoing participant recruitment challenges in dementia research highlight the need to understand public perspectives on research participation. This scoping review explored existing literature on barriers and enablers to the recruitment and retention of participants in dementia studies.MethodsA scoping review was conducted in PubMed and PsycINFO, following the Arksey and O’Malley framework, using a keyword profile informed by a pilot search (full protocol available at osf.io/n8j4u). Abstract and full text screening were performed in duplicate and data were extracted using predefined criteria.

pmc-13150697.title: Nano-cobalt anchored on chitosan-derived N-doped porous carbon: an efficient catalyst for α-alkylation of ketones with alcohols via borrowing hydrogen
pmc-13150697.creator: Zegang Zhang, Dongbin Mo, Youjuan Tan, Xueqin Chang, Lin Chen, Xianglin Pei
pmc-13150697.description: To address the challenges in developing green and efficient heterogeneous catalysis for the α-alkylation of ketones via the borrowing hydrogen strategy, a novel supported cobalt nanoparticle (QNCM@Co) catalyst was rationally designed and prepared. This catalyst features nano-cobalt anchored on N-doped porous carbon microspheres derived from quinoline-8-carboxaldehyde-modified chitosan microspheres.

pmc-13280442.title: Epidemiology and risk factors of stroke in the Americas: a comprehensive narrative literature review
pmc-13280442.creator: Gisele Sampaio Silva, Jose Danilo Diestro, Christopher Tarzi, Teruko Kishibe, Antonio Bernabé-Ortiz, Rodrigo M Carrillo-Larco, Bruce Ovbiagele, Gustavo Saposnik, Carlos Abanto, Matias Alet, Bassel Almarie, Tony Fabián Alvarez, Pablo Amaya, Sebastian Ameriso, Antonio Arauz, Miguel A Barboza, Hernán B
pmc-13280442.description: SummaryStroke remains a leading cause of death and disability across the Americas, disproportionately affecting low- and middle-income countries. According to the 2023 Global Burden of Disease (GBD) Study, the Americas recorded approximately 1.2 million incident strokes and 15.7 million prevalent cases. This narrative review synthesizes epidemiological evidence on stroke trends in the Americas, with emphasis on disparities in healthcare access.

pmc-13301451.title: PHSNet: A Small-Target Infrared Hotspot Detection Network for Photovoltaic Modules in UAV Remote-Sensing Images
pmc-13301451.creator: Bingpeng Gao, Yunbo Yang, Xingzhi Chen, Xin Cai, Xinyuan Nan
pmc-13301451.description: With the rapid expansion of global photovoltaic (PV) installed capacity, hot spot defects have become a major hidden danger that reduces power generation efficiency and threatens the safe and stable operation of PV stations. Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) infrared remote sensing is a key technology for the efficient intelligent monitoring of large-scale PV stations.

pmc-13404004.title: Delay in Diagnosis of Addison's Disease: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-13404004.creator: Ishita Bhattacharya, Lisle Blackbourn, Manajyoti Yadav

pmc-13409010.title: Specificity and Sensitivity of Circulating Tumor HPV-DNA in Patients with HPV-Positive Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-13409010.creator: Jakob Myllerup Jensen, Simone Kloch Bendtsen, Kathrine Kronberg Jakobsen, Benedicte Bitsch Lauritzen, Katalin Kiss, Maria Rossing, Jeppe Friborg, Christian Grønhøj, Christian von Buchwald
pmc-13409010.description: The global incidence of oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) is increasing, mainly due to a rise in human papillomavirus-positive (HPV+) cases. In Denmark, this group now constitutes more than 70% of newly diagnosed patients with OPSCC, making HPV+ OPSCC an increasing health issue. Approximately 10–15% of patients experience recurrence after treatment, and 30% die within five years of diagnosis.

pmc-13439765.title: Dynamics of tumor ecosystems and microbiome in response to neoadjuvant ABFOLFOX treatment in patients with unresectable colorectal cancer with liver metastasis
pmc-13439765.creator: Wonkyung Kim, Jeong Eun Kim, Yong Sang Hong, Dae Wook Hwang, Jihun Kim, Ji Sung Lee, Jin Ho Shin, Tae Won Kim, Deepti Nagarkar, Allyson Byrd, Chang Ohk Sung, Sun Young Kim
pmc-13439765.description: BackgroundThis study aims to explore the effects of neoadjuvant atezolizumab, bevacizumab, leucovorin, 5-fluorouracil, and oxaliplatin (ABFOLFOX) in patients with unresectable colorectal liver metastases (CRLM), focusing on the molecular dynamics of tumor ecosystems (TE) of CRLM and their impact on treatment outcomes.
